title: Patient involvement among severely affected individuals with post-acute infection syndromes
summary: The study “Patient Involvement Among Severely Affected Individuals with Post-Acute Infection Syndromes” aims to identify the expectations, opportunities, and potential experiences of severely affected individuals with post-acute infection syndromes (PAIS) regarding patient involvement in research processes in Germany. To this end, interviews are being conducted with (formerly) severely affected PAIS patients. Individuals who, due to their functional limitations, are unable to participate in an interview in the form of a conversation will be given the opportunity to answer the interview questions via audio recordings instead.

interventions.name: Conducting telephone-based individual interviews with (formerly) severely affected patients experiencing post-acute infection syndromes, in order to explore their expectations, opportunities, and, where applicable, prior experiences with patient involvement in research processes in Germany.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- (formerly) Patients with severe post-acute infection syndromes
- (formerly) (primarily) homebound and/or bedridden
- Age ≥ 18 years
- Sufficient knowledge of German
- Ability to give informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
- Under 18 years of age
- Lack of legal capacity
- Insufficient knowledge of German
